author: Nancy Burns-Fusaro
title: "Lost Lear" comes to Connecticut College Saturday
text:
NEW LONDON — "Lost Lear," written and directed by Dan Colley, will be performed at 7:30 p.m. Saturday, Oct. 25, 2025, at Connecticut College’s Athey Center, Palmer Auditorium.
“Lost Lear” comes to Connecticut College Saturday
Nancy Burns-Fusaro
